lines.text: What is Pomerol's crasse de fer?
lines.ph: wˌɒt ɪz pˈɒmɛɹˌɒlz kɹˈas də fˈɛɹ?

lines.text: Just nine hundred and sixty-four hectares.
lines.ph: dʒˈʌst nˈaɪn hˈʌndɹɪd and sˈɪkstifˈɔː hˈɛkteəz.

lines.text: The ground averages just twenty-four metres.
lines.ph: ðə ɡɹˈaʊnd ˈavɹɪdʒɪz dʒˈʌst twˈɛntifˈɔː mˈiːtəz.

lines.text: A gentle plateau, sloping down to the river Isle.
lines.ph: ɐ dʒˈɛntəl plˈatəʊ, slˈəʊpɪŋ dˌaʊn tə ðə ɹˈɪvəɹ ˈiːl.

lines.text: Crasse de fer means iron oxides in the subsoil, under gravel, sand and clay.
lines.ph: kɹˈas də fˈɛɹ mˈiːnz ˈaɪən ˈɒksaɪdz ɪnðə sˈʌbsɔɪl, ˌʌndə ɡɹˈavəl, sˈand and klˈeɪ.

lines.text: Seven hundred and ninety-eight millimetres of rain next door. Less than Bordeaux-Mérignac.
lines.ph: sˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd and nˈaɪntiˈeɪt mˈɪlɪmˌiːtəz ɒv ɹˈeɪn nˈɛkst dˈɔː. lˈɛs ðɐn bˈɔːdəʊ mˌeɪɹiːnjˈak.

lines.text: Over two thousand one hundred hours of sun a year, and seventy-two more than Bordeaux-Mérignac.
lines.ph: ˌəʊvə tˈuː θˈaʊzənd wˈɒn hˈʌndɹɪd ˈaʊəz ɒv sˈʌn ɐ jˈiə, and sˈɛvəntitˈuː mˈɔː ðɐn bˈɔːdəʊ mˌeɪɹiːnjˈak.

lines.text: Five grapes are allowed, all red. Merlot dominates.
lines.ph: fˈaɪv ɡɹˈeɪps ɑːɹ ɐlˈaʊd, ˈɔːl ɹˈɛd. mɜːlˈəʊ dˈɒmɪnˌeɪts.

lines.text: Base yield: forty-nine hectolitres per hectare.
lines.ph: bˈeɪs jˈiːld: fˈɔːtinˈaɪn hˈɛktəlˌiːtəz pɜː hˈɛkteə.

lines.text: Test yourself. Three questions. Answers in the first comment.
lines.ph: tˈɛst jɔːsˈɛlf. θɹˈiː kwˈɛstʃənz. ˈansəz ɪnðə fˈɜːst kˈɒmɛnt.

lines.text: Study it free at open wine atlas dot com.
lines.ph: stˈʌdi ɪt fɹˈiː at ˈəʊpən wˈaɪn ˈatləs dˈɒt kˈɒm.
